policy: Native player-name labels are allowed; exclude edited captions, corner HUD and facecams.
limits: Manual detection-level labels, not clip approval. Zero observed false allows in this small sample is not proof of zero misses. All detections in every frame must still pass; a native label cannot excuse another caption in the same frame. Small/colored/occluded native labels can remain conservatively rejected. Source reviews and stratified full-frame audits remain required.
